columns.validationmsg: "Please enter valid value for Total Pieces"
columns.name: totalpieces

table.retrieve:
SELECT 	
	item.customicode, 
	receiptdetail.alternatecustomicode,
	item.name, 
	currlistrow = 0,
	stock=0.0000,
	totalstock=0.0000,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.receiptinvcode,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.gcode,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.icode,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.batch,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.manfdate,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.expiry,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.price,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.packunits,      
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.purchaseprice,   
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.priority,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.avgprice,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.mrpp,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.saleprice,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.Sectcode,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.UpdateAvgPrice,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.NewAvgPrice,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.CurrStock,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.PiecesInHand,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.TotalPieces,
	itemcode = 0,
	receiptutn=dbo.ReceiptDetail.receiptutn,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.ItemDescription,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.SaleOrderRowID,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.IssueRowID,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.RowID,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.unitweight,
	QE1=dbo.ReceiptDetail.QE1, 
	QE2=dbo.ReceiptDetail.QE2, 
	QE3=dbo.ReceiptDetail.QE3, 
	QE4=dbo.ReceiptDetail.QE4, 
	QE5=dbo.ReceiptDetail.QE5, 
	WE1=dbo.ReceiptDetail.WE1, 
	WE2=dbo.ReceiptDetail.WE2, 
	WE3=dbo.ReceiptDetail.WE3, 
	WE4=dbo.ReceiptDetail.WE4, 
	WE5=dbo.ReceiptDetail.WE5,
	issueableqty=ReceiptDetail.qty,
	dbo.ReceiptDetail.qty
FROM 
	dbo.ReceiptDetail, 
	dbo.item
WHERE 
	( dbo.ReceiptDetail.receiptinvcode = :r_InvCode )   and
	( dbo.ReceiptDetail.icode = dbo.item.icode )

objects.name: compute_13
objects.expression: sum(c_qe1 + c_qe2 + c_qe3 + c_qe4 + c_qe5 + c_we1 + c_we2 + c_we3 + c_we4 + c_we5  for all)

objects.name: c_itemexpenses
objects.expression: c_qe1 + c_qe2 + c_qe3 + c_qe4 + c_qe5 + c_we1 + c_we2 + c_we3 + c_we4 + c_we5
